You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

picks.reason: Tests whether the phosphazene base can improve on the best-performing L2–B3–A9 combination while retaining its strongest additive.
Checks whether A9’s strong performance is retained with the BrettPhos analogue, though L2 has so far been the more promising ligand.
Tests the close positional isomer of A9 under the leading conditions to assess the apparent sensitivity to ester placement.
Explores an ester-bearing isoxazole analogue under the leading conditions, with its additional methoxy substituent providing a useful structural comparison.
Tests a simpler methylisoxazole analogue under the leading conditions to determine whether A9’s ester is essential to its strong result.
